name: BankX Router swapXSDForETH pays ETH before burning the pool's XSD
summary: BankX Router.swapXSDForETH() sends the ETH to the caller with safeTransferETH before XSD.burnpoolXSD() burns a tenth of the caller-chosen amountInMax from the XSD/WETH pool and syncs it. On Ethereum the attacker bought 80,000 XSD with 500 flash-loaned ETH through swapETHForXSD, sold them back through swapXSDForETH for 450 ETH and, from its receive hook, swapped 1,950 WETH into the pool for 78,042 XSD, so the burn then removed 8,000 XSD from a reserve left with 8,001; it sold 20,000 XSD back at the inflated price for 2,004.34 WETH. It was repeated on that Router on 2023-09-24 and on BankX's BSC Router, of the same code, on 2023-09-26. In February 2025 attackers repeated it on BankX's redeployed Routers on six chains, which added a per-sender block delay but kept the order, by making each router call from a fresh helper contract.
notes: Reset is the owner's XSD.setCollateralEthPool (XSD slot 0x9) on 2023-07-12. burnpoolXSD requires XSD's totalSupply() less the collateral pool's collat_XSD() to exceed the burn, and XSD, the Router and the PID controller had pointed at 0xc923b420, a library whose collat_XSD() reverts, so any swapXSDForETH that would burn reverted. The Router (setCollateralPool, slot 0x34) and the PID controller were repointed to the collateral pool 0x9c117ca0 on 2023-07-09 and XSD on 2023-07-12, which first made the exploited path usable; the anchor reverts with any of the three old pointers (rule 8). The reset postdates the Router deployment, Router.initialize, which set the PID controller (slot 0x41), and XSD.setRouterAddress (slot 0xa), which granted the Router burnpoolXSD. Later changes the exploit read are live values: the collateral pool's collat_XSD and the PID controller's state, updated by mints and swaps.

0x42abe1f4 created the attack contract 0x85a300b4 five minutes before the anchor and sent 4.3 ETH to Tornado Cash within fifteen minutes after it. campaign.mjs over swapETHForXSD and swapXSDForETH on the Ethereum Router from its deployment to the current block finds only EOA callers besides the anchor and 0x9dcda952, whose contract 0xcc4237f3 swapped 952 flash-loaned WETH into the pool for XSD from its receive hook, and an EOA cannot re-enter; the pool's and the Router's WETH outflows before the anchor are EOA swaps of at most 0.23 WETH.

BankX's BSC Router 0xfadda925, created in June 2023 by the Ethereum Router's deployer 0x03e33bab with the same swapXSDForETH, is a sibling deployment (rule 4). In eip155:56:0xbdf76f22 the attacker sold 39,566 XSD through it for 9.84 BNB and, from its receive hook, swapped 3,800 flash-loaned WBNB into the pool for 263,933 XSD, so the burn removed 3,957 XSD from a nearly emptied reserve; it sold the XSD back for 3,857 WBNB. campaign.mjs over swapXSDForETH and swapETHForBankX on that Router from its deployment to the current block finds only EOA callers besides it.

The 2025 transactions hit the Routers BankX deployed from August to December 2024 (BSC 0xaadae911, Ethereum 0xf441252d, Optimism 0xb17832d2, Polygon 0xf37c90e8, Avalanche 0x8eb9d9f5, Base 0x59ca927a; the same bytecode up to immutables outside BSC, whose verified source matches). They add a deadline and a blockDelay modifier keyed on msg.sender, but swapXSDForETH still sends the ETH before burnpoolXSD, so they are sibling deployments of the same code (rule 4). On 2025-02-06 and 2025-02-07, 0x867aa2a2 (Polygon, Optimism and BSC twice), 0x18f9f77b (Ethereum), 0xb1091d39 (Avalanche, five transactions) and 0x35e1b054 (Base, two) called swapXSDForETH from one helper contract, whose receive hook had a second helper buy XSD with swapETHForXSD before the burn, and sold the XSD back from a third; SolidityScan and SlowMist (refs) report the BSC, Ethereum and Optimism legs. Scanning every log of the XSD/WETH pools these routers and Arbitrum's 0x00515ca4 trade on, from each pool's creation, for transactions with several pool swaps not sent to a BankX router finds these twelve and no other before BankX replaced the routers in late February 2025.

Loss: loss.mjs with the XSD/WETH pools (Ethereum 0x12b4718f in 2023 and 0x53f51fcd in 2025, BSC 0xbfbcb8bd in 2023 and 0x8a4e0e2a in 2025, Optimism 0xab1c27a3, Polygon 0x58421507, Avalanche and Base 0x1ff77d8e) as victims gives 4.47 WETH ($7,361.59) on Ethereum in 2023, 4.34 in the anchor and 0.13 in 0x9dcda952; 66.80 WBNB in eip155:56:0xbdf76f22 less the 9.95 BNB that attacker paid the pool for the 39,566 XSD in its setup transaction 0x9403b1e6 (refs, rule 11), both priced at eip155:56:0xbdf76f22, 56.85 WBNB ($12,041.75); and in 2025 58.08 WBNB ($33,610.51), 3.23 WETH on Ethereum, 244.20 WAVAX, 0.53 WETH on Optimism, 0.27 WETH on Base and 2,394.09 WPOL, $51,201.17, against SlowMist's $43k for the 2025 BSC, Ethereum and Optimism legs. $70,604.51 in all. The pools' XSD is valued at nothing (rule 12).
